confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Zhangjiajie prices. Zhangjiajie-specific data was thin. Beer came from a local-pub figure of about 9-12 RMB. Meals came from rough local per-person figures and a China-wide cappuccino average of about 22 RMB. I found no Zhangjiajie cappuccino price, and the cocktail and wine anchors are estimated from the beer price and typical Chinese tourist-city price relationships. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against listings. Prices in the Wulingyuan scenic area run higher, especially in peak season. For the FX rate I used the RBA 4pm rate for 18 Nov 2026. The RBA table also showed a figure of 0.6677 for 19 Nov, but I couldn't confirm it as an official 4pm rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on a typical smaller Chinese tourist city in Hunan, with a premium for the Wulingyuan scenic-area tourism market and a China-wide average for cappuccino.
